name: dymaxion
description: /pause stops Claude at its next step without adding to the context, and stays paused until you send a prompt; optionally pauses at a quota limit and resumes when the quota resets

quotaLimit.title: Pause at quota percent
quotaLimit.description: Pause when the 5-hour or weekly limit reaches this percent. 0 turns it off. /pause limit changes it for one session.

quotaResume.title: Resume when the quota resets
quotaResume.description: After a quota pause, send a prompt to continue once the window that paused the session resets.

quotaCompact.title: Compact on a quota pause
quotaCompact.description: When a quota pause starts, compact the conversation while the prompt cache is warm.
